top_categories.workout_context: 882 miles. Your legs will beg to quit after 120. This trains the power output you need from mile 130 onward.
At Bohemian Border Bash, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
82,972ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
94ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
882 miles rewards fat oxidation. This volume work shifts your fuel mix so you're still burning fat at hour 5, not bonking at hour 3.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 882 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
Bohemian Border Bash's Gravel roads, Forest tracks forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 882 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Bohemian Border Bash's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before September.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Bohemian Border Bash. Train it until it feels boring.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 82,972ft of climbing on gravel roads, forest tracks and old asphalt does to your power file on race day.
Low-cadence force work for 82,972ft of climbing. The slow, grinding ascents where you can't spin—you push.
82,972ft of climbing means repeated surges above threshold. VO2max work is how you survive the fifth climb, not just the first.

race_overlay.nutrition: Ultra-distance fueling for 882 miles: 80–100g carbs/hour from mile 1 — don’t wait until you’re hungry. Practice your exact race-day nutrition in every long training ride. Carry backup calories. 882 miles burns 8,000–12,000+ calories — you cannot replace them all, but you must try.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Bohemian Border Bash requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on gravel roads, forest tracks and old asphalt across six border ranges to build confidence. Expect: gravel roads, forest tracks, old asphalt.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, Over Under, and Mixed Climbing to prepare you for 882 miles of gravel roads, forest tracks and old asphalt across six border ranges in Srbská Kamenice, Czech Republic.
